components.name: Search Field
components.description: Square, paper-toned search and selection field.

components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #9a9c94); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper, #e7e3d8); color: var(--ink, #171816); padding: 0 .7rem; font: 400 1rem/1.5 sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #0b69a3); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Theme Segments
components.description: A shared ruled group with a reversed selected state.
components.css: .ds-segments { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #9a9c94); } .ds-segments button { min-height: 38px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule, #9a9c94); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #60655f); font: 400 .72rem/1.4 sans-serif; } .ds-segments button:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-segments .is-active { background: var(--ink, #171816); color: var(--paper, #e7e3d8); } .ds-segments button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #0b69a3); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Language Navigation
components.description: A native-language label opens ruled links to every static locale. English is the root and fallback. The English root may show a dismissible browser-language suggestion without redirecting or changing proof content.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-language { position: relative; } .ds-language nav { position: absolute; right: 0; display: grid; min-width: 11rem; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #171816); background: var(--paper, #e7e3d8); } .ds-language a { min-height: 42px; padding: .7rem .85rem; } .ds-language a + a { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #9a9c94); } .ds-language a:hover, .ds-language a[aria-current=page] { background: var(--ink, #171816); color: var(--paper, #e7e3d8); }

components.name: Proof Presets
components.description: A continuous ruled multi-select for nine ordered multilingual proofs. All is independent; direct specimen editing changes the state to custom. The summary reports selected presets and unique required code points.
components.html:
測試範本

9 組範本 · 267 個必要字元
components.css: .ds-proof-presets { border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #9a9c94); border-radius: 0; } .ds-proof-presets > div { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #9a9c94); background: var(--rule, #9a9c94); } .ds-proof-presets button { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; min-height: 38px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper, #e7e3d8); color: var(--muted, #60655f); font: 400 .72rem/1.4 sans-serif; } .ds-proof-presets button.is-active { background: var(--ink, #171816); color: var(--paper, #e7e3d8); } .ds-proof-presets button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #0b69a3); outline-offset: -3px; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-proof-presets button { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Coverage Status
components.description: Literal coverage evidence in the active interface language inside a one-pixel semantic rule.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-block; padding: .35rem .5rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 0; color: var(--success, #1e6650); font: 400 .75rem/1.4 sans-serif; }

components.name: Embed Action
components.description: High-contrast copy action attached directly to embed markup.
components.css: .ds-embed-action { min-width: 110px; min-height: 42px; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule, #9a9c94); border-radius: 0; background: var(--ink, #171816); color: var(--paper, #e7e3d8); font: 400 .8rem/1.4 sans-serif; } .ds-embed-action:hover { background: var(--accent, #c84125); color: var(--accent-ink, #fff8ef); } .ds-embed-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #0b69a3); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Font Specimen
components.description: A full-width ruled specimen with attached package metadata and an editable textarea. Visible fields synchronize immediately; offscreen fields receive the latest proof before display or focus. Stylesheets preload within one viewport of the visible area, while content-visibility contains offscreen rendering.
components.html:
Taipei Sans TC

@vp-tw/cjk-web-fonts-taipei-sans-tc@0.0.1
components.css: .ds-specimen { border-top: 1px solid var(--ink, #171816); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink, #171816); background: var(--paper, #e7e3d8); color: var(--ink, #171816); content-visibility: auto; contain-intrinsic-size: auto 520px; } .ds-specimen header { padding: 1rem 3vw; } .ds-specimen h3 { margin: 0; font: 500 1.35rem/1.3 sans-serif; } .ds-specimen code { color: var(--muted, #60655f); font: 400 .72rem/1.4 ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-proof { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 140px; max-height: min(60vh, 720px); padding: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem); resize: vertical; border: 0; border-radius: 0; overflow: auto; font-size: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 5rem); line-height: 1.35; }

components.name: PWA Update Notice
components.description: A ruled, responsive status slip in the active interface language for offline readiness, waiting updates, and update-activation failures. Every static locale is available through the shared offline app shell. Entry motion is disabled when reduced motion is requested.

components.css: .ds-pwa-notice { position: fixed; right: 3vw; bottom: 3vw; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.75rem minmax(0, 1fr); width: min(42rem, 94vw); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #171816); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper, #e7e3d8); color: var(--ink, #171816); } .ds-pwa-notice button { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--ink, #171816); border-radius: 0; } .ds-pwa-notice button:first-of-type { background: var(--ink, #171816); color: var(--paper, #e7e3d8); } .ds-pwa-notice button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #0b69a3); outline-offset: -3px; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-pwa-notice { right: 0; bottom: 0; grid-template-columns: 2.25rem minmax(0, 1fr); width: 100%; border-right: 0; border-bottom: 0; border-left: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-pwa-notice { animation: pwa-notice-in 220ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) both; } }

narrative.overview: CJK Web Fonts feels like an international typographic standards manual opened on a press-room desk. The interface is calm, exact, and visibly maintained. Warm specification paper, registration ink, numbered controls, and hairline rules give each decision a traceable place without competing with the type specimens. The product is an operating surface, not a promotional page. Editable text and calibrated controls lead; package, coverage, license, source, and CDN facts remain attached to the specimen they describe. The visual system avoids decorative print effects that do not support a task.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper fields with high-contrast ink and sparse proof-red emphasis.
Square controls, continuous rules, and measured typographic spacing.
Large live specimens paired with compact technical metadata.
Explicit states and literal labels instead of ornamental marks.
Package and delivery relationships remain visibly traceable.

rules.name: The One Proof Ink Rule
rules.body: Proof Red is the only general accent. Do not introduce additional decorative accent colors.

rules.name: The Status Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Green and Missing Red communicate verified coverage states only; never use them as general decoration.

rules.name: The Specimen Owns the Typeface Rule
rules.body: Interface typography stays neutral. Catalog fonts appear in live specimen regions, never in navigation or controls.

rules.name: The Data Stays Compact Rule
rules.body: Technical metadata may be small, but must retain readable contrast, explicit units, and complete package identifiers.

rules.name: The Specimen Is the Input Rule
rules.body: Preview text is edited in context. Do not add a separate master-proof field above the catalog.

rules.name: The Proof Order Is Stable Rule
rules.body: Keep the nine multilingual proof presets in their curated order when composing a multi-selection. Treat All and custom content as independent states.

rules.name: The Printed Plane Rule
rules.body: Do not use drop shadows, glass effects, bevels, or simulated paper texture. A region earns separation through structure and tone.

rules.name: The Square Instrument Rule
rules.body: Keep operational fields and containers square. Circular geometry is reserved for the swap control or a semantically circular mark.

rules.name: The Approved Brand Mark Rule
rules.body: Use the approved raster mark made from 字, あ, and 한 without redrawing, recoloring, or adding effects. Render it at 40px inside a 44px Specification Paper field when the surrounding surface could hide its registration-ink details.

rules.name: The Social Preview Rule
rules.body: Use the approved Open Graph raster with the official tagline verbatim. Keep its generated source alongside the 1200 by 630 delivery image, and resize only without redrawing, recoloring, sharpening, or adding effects.

rules.name: The Explicit Language Rule
rules.body: Publish every interface language at a crawlable static URL. Keep English as the root fallback, preserve explicit choices, and offer browser-language suggestions without forced redirects or proof-content changes.

dos: Do keep the user's text, controls, coverage result, package version, and embed code in one traceable workflow.
Do use one-pixel rules and paper-tone shifts to establish hierarchy.
Do preserve visible focus, explicit status labels, and WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.
Do model new weights and variants as data attached to the same specimen structure.
Do write interface copy as short task labels or verifiable facts.
donts: Don't turn specimens into rounded cards, tiles, or a generic dashboard grid.
Don't add shadows, gradients, fake ink, grain, crop marks, or registration decoration without an operational purpose.
Don't use catalog typefaces for interface chrome.
Don't detach license, source, version, or CDN information from the font it describes.
Don't fabricate availability, performance, popularity, or legal claims.
